name: Hushwave
summary: A calm headphone product page where scrolling plays a film of the headphones opening up
about: A light, minimal one-page site for a pair of noise-cancelling headphones. A tall sticky section draws the headphones on a canvas frame by frame from your scroll: they turn, the ear cups open into cushion, driver, battery and shell, then close again, with captions and a scrubber. A colour picker recolours the film, the hero and the order card, and the page ends with a noise-cancelling before/after slider, a model comparison and a working pre-order.
how: The hero rises in word by word while the headphones drop into place and quiet ripples spread out
Scroll into the film: the headphones turn, open into four labelled layers and close again as you scroll
Drag the thin scrubber or press Shape, Open, Inside, Mics or Close to jump through the film
Pick Sand, Sage, Graphite or Blush to recolour the film, the hero art and the pre-order picture
Drag across the before/after panel, switch between City bus, Open office and Flight, or try Aware mode
Switch the specs between two models, set colour, quantity and a travel case, then pre-order to see it reserve
